house-ai.description: House AI's hosted MCP server for interior and exterior design: redesign rooms, house exteriors and yards from a photo in 100+ styles, preview wall paint and flooring, and find furniture and decor from partner stores. Browsing styles works without an account. Design tools need a House AI account and use its credits; sign-in is OAuth, so after installing run /mcp in Claude Code to sign in. Clients without OAuth can send a personal API token as an Authorization: Bearer header.
